game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when rogue crows strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when rogue crows strike. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the granary door using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the granary door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 18.
